map.为什么有每日上限？: Why is there a daily cap?
map.体积 = 体重 × 剂量(mg/kg) / 浓度: Volume = body weight x dose (mg/kg) / concentration
map.儿童退热液量计算器。按体重换算对乙酰氨基酚混悬液体积，提示每日上限约 75 mg: Child antipyretic dose calculator. Converts the volume of paracetamol suspension from body weight and notes a daily cap of about 75 mg/kg, as a dose reference for antipyretics in children (follow the package insert).
map.医疗健康类结果为按公式得到的估算值，不能替代医生诊断与处方。给药剂量、补液速度、: Results in the medical and health category are estimates from formulas and cannot replace a doctor's diagnosis or prescription. Dosing, infusion rate and anticoagulation or thrombolysis decisions must follow the package insert, clinical guidelines and the attending physician. For emergencies such as chest pain, breathing difficulty or altered consciousness, seek medical care immediately.
map.安全上限：由每日最大剂量 75 mg/kg 反推每日最多服用次数: Safety cap: back out the maximum number of doses per day from the daily maximum of 75 mg/kg
map.对乙酰氨基酚单日累计超过 75mg/kg 有肝损伤风险；按上限反推次数可防重复用: A single-day cumulative paracetamol dose above 75 mg/kg risks liver damage; working backwards from the cap prevents accidental overdose from duplicate dosing. Many cold medicines contain this ingredient, so the totals must be added up.
map.居家给药：按体重换算对乙酰氨基酚混悬液体积，避免凭感觉倒: Home dosing: convert the volume of paracetamol suspension from body weight instead of eyeballing it
map.浓度怎么看？: How do I read the concentration?
map.混悬液标签标 mg/mL（或 mg/5mL）；若标\"每 5mL 含 160mg: The suspension label states mg/mL (or mg/5 mL). If it reads "160 mg per 5 mL", the concentration is 32 mg/mL. Always check the concentration before converting the volume, since brands differ a lot.
map.用药教育：提示间隔与总剂量，防止重复用药过量伤肝: Medication education: explain the interval and the total dose to prevent liver injury from duplicate dosing
map.：例1（体重 15kg、剂量 15mg/kg、浓度 32mg/mL）：单次 =: : Example 1 (weight 15kg, dose 15mg/kg, concentration 32mg/mL): one dose = 15×15/32 = 7.0mL; the daily cap = floor(75/15) = 5 times (that is, once every 4 hours, no more than 5 times a day). Example 2 (weight 10kg, dose 10mg/kg, concentration 32mg/mL): one dose = 10×10/32 = 3.1mL; the daily cap = floor(75/10) = 7 times.
map.：算法：单次体积 = 体重(kg) × 剂量(mg/kg) ÷ 浓度(mg/mL: : Algorithm: single-dose volume = weight (kg) × dose (mg/kg) ÷ concentration (mg/mL); maximum doses per day = floor(daily limit 75 mg/kg ÷ single dose). Weight, dose, and concentration must all be > 0. The result is for conversion reference only; actual dosing must follow the package insert and medical advice.
